font.method: Direct monochrome rasterization from font outlines at 16px; never scaled from small bitmap.
font.charset: Complete printable Unicode cmap of the actual UI Webfont, including German umlauts and ß.

postgame.policy: Six neutral morning foregrounds, one per city. No reopened institutions or repopulation asserted. For evacuated Calderwick / burned Varrowmouth, use with state-appropriate city backdrop supplied by integration; foreground alone does not alter world state.
